edges.reason: msg.sender drives the mint entrypoint branch logic and per-caller limits.
msg.sender is the recipient of the low-level dust refund call inside mint.
The low-level call transfers control to msg.sender before addressMintedBalance is updated and tokens are minted.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, re-entering the mint flow.
addressMintedBalance[msg.sender] is read into ownerMintedCount.
ownerMintedCount plus _mintAmount is written back to addressMintedBalance[msg.sender].
cost is copied into the differCost local variable.
differCost is multiplied by _mintAmount to compute totalCost.
_mintAmount is a factor of the totalCost computation.
totalCost determines the dust ETH amount forwarded in the refund call.
dustEth is the value passed to the low-level refund call.
The success flag of the refund call is required to be true.
maxSupply bounds supply.add(_mintAmount) inside mint.
maxMintAmount bounds the _mintAmount argument in mint.
nftPerAddressLimit bounds ownerMintedCount.add(_mintAmount).
nftGiveawayLimit bounds the amount in a giveaway mint.
The paused flag gates entry into mint.
onlyWhitelisted gates whether the caller must pass the whitelist check.
mint calls isWhitelisted(msg.sender) to enforce whitelist access control.
mint calls giveawayList(msg.sender) to determine free mint eligibility.
whitelistedAddresses mapping is read by isWhitelisted.
giveawayAddresses mapping is read by giveawayList.
giveawayAddresses[msg.sender] is reset to false after a giveaway mint.
msg.sender indexes the addressMintedBalance mapping for reads and writes.
withdraw performs a low-level call sending the full balance to owner().
withdraw is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
reveal is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
setNftPerAddressLimit is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
setCost is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
setmaxMintAmount is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
setBaseURI is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
pause is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
setOnlyWhitelisted is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
addWhitelistUsers is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
addGiveawayUsers is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner().
reveal writes the revealed state variable.
setOnlyWhitelisted toggles the onlyWhitelisted state variable.
setNftPerAddressLimit writes nftPerAddressLimit.
setCost writes the cost state variable.
setmaxMintAmount writes maxMintAmount.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
pause toggles the paused state variable.
addWhitelistUsers writes whitelistedAddresses entries.
addGiveawayUsers writes giveawayAddresses entries.
_users array elements are written into whitelistedAddresses.
_users array elements are written into giveawayAddresses.
baseURI is returned by _baseURI.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the current base URI.
baseURI content is concatenated into the returned token URI.
revealed controls whether tokenURI returns the hidden metadata URI.
tokenId is used for existence checks and URI concatenation.
_owner is used to query balance and enumerate owned tokens.
supply.add(_mintAmount) checks and supply.add(i) token IDs rely on arithmetic accumulation.
The loop counter i bounds the minting loop that mints supply.add(i).
_mintAmount is added to addressMintedBalance and to supply in unchecked-by-arithmetic-sensitive paths.
The os boolean is the success check of the withdraw low-level call.
owner() supplies the recipient address for the withdraw balance transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: _mintAmount is a mint argument; it is fully derived from untrusted caller input and belongs to the mint function.
_user is only a lookup key for isWhitelisted and has no independent semantics.
_user is only a lookup key for giveawayList and has no independent semantics.
_owner is only used inside walletOfOwner for enumeration.
tokenId is only used inside tokenURI for existence checks and URI construction.
_limit is the direct input of the setNftPerAddressLimit setter.
_newCost is the direct input of the setCost setter.
_newmaxMintAmount is the direct input of the setmaxMintAmount setter.
_newBaseURI is the direct input of the setBaseURI setter.
_users drives the whitelist batch write loop in addWhitelistUsers.
_users drives the giveaway batch write loop in addGiveawayUsers.
supply is a transient cache of totalSupply inside mint.
differCost is a transient copy of cost inside mint.
ownerMintedCount is a transient read of addressMintedBalance inside mint.
totalCost is an intermediate value used only for the mint payment check.
dustEth is the exact value forwarded by the unsafe dust refund low-level call.
success is the required result flag of the unsafe dust refund low-level call.
i is the loop counter of the minting loop inside mint.
ownerTokenCount is an intermediate balance cache inside walletOfOwner.
tokenIds is the return array constructed inside walletOfOwner.
currentBaseURI is an intermediate read of _baseURI inside tokenURI.
os is the required result flag of the unsafe withdraw low-level call.
